method: Blender 4.5.9 CPU, original new editable contour meshes, shape-keyed sewn cloth and articulated feather vanes on read-only selected mesh-v8 derivations

resource_cap.batch: one unit per invocation; seven small frames

camera: Inherit selected mesh-v8 orthographic camera without changing its transform, lens, light or root. Half-resolution scratch only. Fixed shared base calibration across both variants of each family.
closure: Each derived candidate.blend packs its inherited textures, editable meshes, shape keys and new keyframes. candidate.json records selected input and packed texture hashes, transforms and pose checks. author_candidate.py plus this recipe reproduce derivation against pinned selected masters; render_saved.py renders self-contained saved candidates without production imports.
limitations: Not a full action cohort, walk/flight/death repair, professional art acceptance, native playback or all14 repair. Original inherited faces/equipment and matte materials still require painter/anatomist review. No imagegen skill or built-in imagegen tool available; no alternate image service used. Historical material provenance remains inherited metadata, not a new generation claim. Rights unresolved.
